title: 1952 London County Council election
summary: Labour swept back to a commanding majority at County Hall, winning 92 of the 129 elected seats on 55.1% of the vote, recovering strongly from the near-dead-heat of 1949. Turnout reached 43.4%.
highlights: Labour wins a strong majority of 92 of 129 seats

council.note: 129 directly elected councillors, plus aldermen chosen by the council. Seat shares are taken from Rallings & Thrasher's record of LCC results.

sources.label: Rallings & Thrasher, London County Council Elections 1889–1961 (Elections Centre)
